content.short: XEO - Oasis of Universe is a team-based first-person shooter in GameFi 2.0 with a focus on player skill.
content.description: XEO - Oasis of Universe is a team-based first-person shooter crafted for the GameFi 2.0 space, where player skill takes center stage over pay-to-earn mechanics. In this virtual arena, 32 players compete in eight teams to complete objectives and secure victory. The experience combines immersive graphics with precise, skill-focused gameplay to deliver a competitive FPS environment. The project is building infrastructure aimed at onboarding the next million Web2 players to Web3, targeting a broad, skill-driven growth of the Web3 gaming audience.
